verdict.rationale: Sentry lets users run it through natural language from AI assistants. Its official MCP server lets assistants search errors, analyze performance, triage issues and manage projects. The docs also say users can stay in agent conversations and "just ask" to set up Sentry, debug error spikes or wire up alerts, and the probe confirms the MCP server exists. Missing for 10: any built-in natural-language console inside Sentry's own UI (it relies on external assistants), full documentation of which actions are possible by natural language, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
